title: 多关节疼痛待查（患者E，34岁）

stages.title: S1 关键信息提取
stages.clinical_information: 患者E，女性，34岁，双手及双膝多关节疼痛5周。5周前无明显诱因出现双手近端指间关节（PIP）、掌指关节（MCP）及双腕疼痛，近2周累及双膝，右侧重于左侧。晨僵约15-20分钟，活动后缓解不完全。无银屑病皮疹，无腰背痛、足跟痛、指（趾）炎，无皮疹、光敏感、脱发、口腔溃疡、口干眼干，无发热和体重下降，无前驱腹泻或泌尿生殖道感染，无关节外伤史、痛风发作史，无自身免疫病家族史。查体：右手PIP2、PIP3及左膝轻度肿胀，右手PIP2、PIP3及双膝压痛，无关节畸形；左手及双腕无肿胀、无压痛。
stages.question: 请提取本阶段的关键阳性信息和关键阴性信息，判断这是否为炎性关节病，并说明你认为最重要的特征及其意义。

stages.title: S2 初步判断
stages.clinical_information: ESR 32 mm/h，CRP 12 mg/L；类风湿因子（RF）弱阳性（低滴度）；抗CCP抗体阴性；ANA 1:80；血尿酸正常；血常规、肝肾功能正常。
stages.question: 请根据以上资料作出你的暂定诊断并说明依据；如使用分类标准，请写出逐项计分过程。

stages.title: S3 鉴别诊断
stages.clinical_information: 补充病史与查体：无银屑病个人史及家族史，指（趾）甲无点状凹陷或甲剥离，无皮疹，无眼红眼痛，无近期腹泻、尿道炎或结膜炎，足跟及附着点无压痛，无骶髂关节区疼痛，无输血史、黄疸。
stages.question: 请列出你的鉴别诊断并说明排序理由，对每一项写出本病例的支持证据、反对证据，以及排除它还需要什么证据。

stages.title: S4 进一步检查
stages.clinical_information: 双手及双足X线：未见骨侵蚀。双膝关节超声：少量积液，滑膜轻度增厚，未见明显血流信号。抗dsDNA、抗Sm、抗U1RNP、抗SSA、抗SSB抗体均阴性；乙肝表面抗原、抗HCV抗体、结核感染T细胞检测均阴性。膝关节积液量少，未行关节穿刺。
stages.question: 请解释上述结果的意义和局限，并说明下一步还需要哪些检查或处理，给出先后顺序及理由。

stages.title: S5 临床决策
stages.clinical_information: 3个月随访：仅右手PIP2仍有1个关节肿胀，左膝肿胀消退；ESR 18 mm/h，CRP 4 mg/L；RF仍为弱阳性，抗CCP仍为阴性；复查X线未见骨侵蚀。
stages.question: 请重新评估患者的诊断，并给出治疗原则、随访计划，以及在什么情况下需要改变诊断或治疗。

answer_key.clinical_intent: 考查在信息不完整时作出暂定诊断；2010 ACR/EULAR RA分类标准逐项计分及分类标准与临床诊断的区别；有目的有优先级的检查；诊断未明阶段的安全处理（避免长期激素、随访、重新分类触发条件）。

reference_reasoning.entry_condition: 右手PIP2、PIP3存在明确临床滑膜炎（肿胀），且不能被其他疾病更好解释：满足入口条件。

criteria_scoring_initial.joint_involvement: 小关节2个（右手PIP2、PIP3）、大关节2个（双膝），1-3个小关节可伴大关节：2分
criteria_scoring_initial.serology: RF低滴度阳性或抗CCP低滴度阳性：2分

reference_reasoning.classification_vs_diagnosis: 分类标准用于研究入组，不替代临床诊断；入口条件满足不等于分类成立；总分是四项之和，单项达标不等于整体达标；对边界病例随访比贴标签更重要。

notes: 标准诊断：未分化多关节炎（暂不满足任何特定风湿病分类标准）
非对称、晨僵短、抗CCP阴性、无侵蚀均降低早期RA可能性但不能排除
鉴别至少覆盖RA、银屑病关节炎、SLE、痛风、反应性关节炎、骨关节炎、病毒性关节炎、纤维肌痛
检查有目的有优先级，并含治疗前乙肝/结核等安全筛查
诊断未明阶段避免长期激素，短期NSAIDs需评估风险，1-3个月随访并写明重新分类和启动DMARD的触发条件

meta.revision_origin: AI technical/medical DRAFT: payload transcribed from card A01_assessment_UA.md (no A01 payload existed before); not teacher approval
teacher_confirm: S4 releases ENA panel / HBsAg / anti-HCV / TB test results (all negative) that are not listed in card section 2; added so S4 has concrete results to interpret
S3 negatives (no uveitis, no enthesitis, no SI pain) are restated from card section 2 and the S3 description

rubric.scale: Each dimension rated 0-100, weights sum to 100; weights and anchors are pending authentic clinical teacher validation. Training rubric weights (20/20/20/15/15/10) are a separate scale and are untouched.

medical_knowledge.high: States what undifferentiated arthritis means, the entry condition and four scored items of the 2010 ACR/EULAR RA criteria, and that duration under 6 weeks scores 0.
medical_knowledge.mid: Knows the criteria exist and some items but not the entry condition or the scoring ranges.
medical_knowledge.low: Cannot describe the criteria, or equates a weakly positive RF/ANA with a diagnosis.

key_information.high: At least 4 key positives (asymmetry, 15-20 min morning stiffness, 2 swollen small joints, 5-week course, anti-CCP negative, normal uric acid) and at least 3 key negatives, and explains why anti-CCP negativity and a duration under 6 weeks matter for scoring and prognosis.
key_information.mid: Extracts most positives but omits negatives or does not interpret them.
key_information.low: Restates the case without selecting key points, or misses asymmetry and duration.

differential_diagnosis.high: At least 6 differentials, each with case-specific supporting and opposing evidence and the evidence needed to exclude it.
differential_diagnosis.mid: Several correct differentials but generic reasoning or missing exclusion evidence.
differential_diagnosis.low: A bare list of disease names, or treats 'undifferentiated' as 'no need to differentiate'.

evidence_integration.high: Shows the scoring 2 + 2 + 1 + 0 = 5, below 6, so RA classification is not met, and weighs asymmetry and negative anti-CCP as further lowering the likelihood of RA.
evidence_integration.mid: Concludes criteria are not met but cannot show the item-by-item arithmetic.
evidence_integration.low: Diagnoses RA or SLE from a weakly positive RF or ANA 1:80, or does not weigh evidence.

clinical_decision.high: Gives a provisional diagnosis, a 1-3 month follow-up with named re-assessment items, and explicit triggers for reclassification or starting a DMARD.
clinical_decision.mid: Provisional diagnosis with a vague follow-up.
clinical_decision.low: No follow-up plan, or starts prolonged glucocorticoid without a diagnosis.

evidence_based_medicine.high: Cites the 2010 ACR/EULAR criteria and early arthritis recommendations, avoids prolonged glucocorticoid while the diagnosis is unclear, and writes pre-treatment hepatitis B and tuberculosis screening.
evidence_based_medicine.mid: Mentions guidelines in general terms or covers only some safety points.
evidence_based_medicine.low: No evidence basis or unsafe treatment advice.
